Omnia AL401 Aluminum Cabinet Hardware

This Omnia Aluminum Pull offers the perfect accent for all your interior drawers and cabinet doors. It is durable and easy to clean while remaining classically stylish. This ensures that it will live up the the Omnia's 40 year legacy of quality while adding a modern style that looks beautiful. Available in 3 inch and 6 inch lengths, this pull comes in aluminum (US28) finish.

Omnia's line of sophisticated Aluminum cabinet hardware have been painstakingly crafted by artisans who understand that a beautiful design must be as comfortable to the hand as it is pleasing to the eyes.

Available in 2 Sizes:

  • OMN-AL401/76 - Center to Center Mount Hole Spacing: 3", Overall Length: 4-5/16", Projection: 7/8"
  • OMN-AL401/152 - Center to Center Mount Hole Spacing: 6", Overall Length: 9-7/16", Projection: 7/8"



*This item is Discontinued.
